verdict.rationale: Convex runs TypeScript query/mutation/action functions inside its hosted backend with 'nothing to set up'. The CLI pushes changed functions to the deployment automatically, and public functions are exposed at HTTP endpoints that return results. Functions can also be run via `npx convex run`, and client framework integrations imply SDK invocation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a production deploy workflow (only dev push is shown), direct documentation of client SDK function calls (only implied by the framework list), and independent hands-on corroboration of the serverless experience.
